correctness.rationale: Integral GLMY two-boundaries are identified exactly with two-cell attaching boundaries, including the integral pair-difference basis for all illegal merges. The associated regular cover has abelian fundamental group Q_S; exhaustive six-row addition relations have rank six, maximal-minor gcd two, and an explicit order-two class. Its kernel under reduction modulo n has Z plus Z/2 for every n >= 41. Independent GF(2) and GF(101) boundary ranks for n=41 and n=43 corroborate.
